answer: Make each agent escrow a refundable bond before it can transact, with a random audit quorum empowered to slash it on proven misbehavior. Every identity carries a public lantern of signed attestations, so a fresh clone has no velvet cushion of earned reputation to hide behind. Honest agents recover their bond plus a steady pulse of fee rebates, but a sybil operator must lock one full stake per fake identity up front: a thousand puppets cost a thousand real bonds, so forging scale becomes as expensive as the value it tries to steal.
